intructions.title: How to play
intructions.body_1: Run away from the invading aliens
intructions.body_2: Help Shaun jump obstacles by pressing the spacebar or clicking your mouse � the other sheep will copy his every move
intructions.body_3: Try not to fall as a sheep will be beamed up!
intructions.body_4: Get as far as you can before all your flock are sheepnapped!

game_screen.tip: Press Space or click the mouse to jump the junk!
game_screen.tip2: Make sure you jump early enough.
game_screen.help: Use either the space bar or the left mouse button to jump.
